title: Ant Group's LingGuang 2.0 Enters Limited Beta as a Personal Agent With Long-Term Memory
source_used: Pandaily (relaying Sina Tech), read from the article text embedded in the page source because the pre-fetch extracted 0 characters
key_facts: Ant Group has quietly started a limited beta of a new version of LingGuang, its multimodal AI assistant, repositioning the app as a personal agent along the lines of Meta's Muse, according to Sina Tech citing people close to the project.
Ant has not made an official announcement.
The sources say Ant began preparing this direction about six months ago, went through several internal versions and plans to open the new release to all users this month.
The new version is described as an AI-native personal agent with long-term memory that can move tasks forward on its own initiative instead of waiting for each prompt.
It can call Skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, which lets it send messages through Alibaba's workplace app DingTalk and operate smart home devices.
Beta use cases cited: monitoring market swings for office workers, helping parents manage check-ins on DingTalk, and reworking a travel route when a flight is delayed.
LingGuang launched in November 2025 as a multimodal assistant answering through code-driven outputs; its Flash App feature builds small apps from a prompt.
Pricing, data handling and the third-party services the new version will connect to at launch have not been disclosed.
quote_evidence: Ant Group has quietly started a limited beta of a new version of LingGuang, its multimodal AI assistant, and is repositioning the app as a personal agent along the lines of Meta's Muse, according to Sina Tech, citing people close to the project.
Ant has not made an official announcement.
Details such as pricing, data handling and which third-party services the new LingGuang will connect to at launch have not been disclosed.
why_it_matters_hint: A large Chinese consumer platform appears to be moving its assistant from answering prompts to acting on its own, but the account rests on unnamed sources.
event_date: Not stated for the beta start; Pandaily published 11 Oct 2026. Full release to all users is planned 'this month' (Oct 2026) per the sources.
